mission.title: Killer
mission.description: Find out what is killing the System's Agents, and destroy it with a virus of their making.

npc.say: I don't understand it... There's no blood. It's like someone just...switched them off.
Agent Pace is waiting for you in the next room.
It's very simple. The intruder's programs access vital sections of our own codebase.
Some code routines cannot be rewritten.
Yes, we are...beginning to evaluate at-risk core routines for possible rewrites.
You must act with great speed, operative. Please go outside and contact Agent Gray. He will guide you now.

phase.briefing:
Operative, we have met with some success countering overridden programs with our operatives, and judicious use of our own programs.
However, we have lost contact with a group of our Agent programs who were being held in reserve for counter-attacks. This requires immediate investigation.

enter.say: That's where our programs stopped responding. I'm not reading anything in particular around the place.

talk.say:
I didn't do it!
I just found them like this...

done.say:
Hm... That guy's verified to be a standard plugged-in bluepill, and his vitals don't show him to be lying.
Not that anything I know of, short of the intruder, could have done that...

phase.briefing:
We are reasonably certain that the intruder himself was not at that location when contact was lost with the Agents, operative.
In fact, an identical situation has just occurred. If this develops into a pattern, it could be the sign of a serious new threat.

enter.say:
Seems like a bad day to be an Agent.
Same deal here: looks dead inside.

done.say: Operative, collect a data sample from Agent Johns.

objective.text: Collect a data sample from Agent Johns

done.say: Okay, now I think we're supposed to take that somewhere for analysis.

phase.briefing: Take the data you retrieved to Agent Pace for further instructions, operative.

enter.say: Pace is supposed to be in there. Lots of computers... Looks like a lab.

talk.say: Please input the data at the computer terminal here, operative. We have to move quickly before more programs are lost.

objective.text: Input the data at the computer terminal

done.say: A program designed to counter this threat is being developed. You will find it waiting for you by the time you reach the computer in the next room.

objective.text: Get the virus from the computer in the next room

done.say: All right. Bring that virus outside.

phase.briefing:
Operative, our analysis of the data you submitted identified the entity responsible for the Agent casualties as a Terminator program. This program, generated by the intruder, can terminate System programs, as can the intruder himself.
The virus you have obtained has the capability to kill the Terminator program, but it must be executed from a computer terminal in the Terminator's vicinity. As our programs cannot approach the Terminator program, you will have to perform this task.

enter.say: Okay, I've got a fix on the thing. I think there is a computer terminal near it that you could use to start that virus. We may only get one chance at this.

objective.text: Run the virus from the computer terminal

done.say: ...and that should do it for our deadly little problem. Nice work.

near.say: There it is! Now, all you gotta do is put the virus in that comput--

mission.finish:
Thank you for eliminating that program, {player}.
I assure you that we are exploring every possible option for ending this crisis created by the intruder.
